reconstitution_law: PRESERVE: every source commit named in this manifest must remain independently fetchable at its exact sha; no repository history may be rewritten, squashed, or force-pushed out from under a recorded sha as a side effect of reconstitution.
FENCE: reconstitution reads and records; it never merges, force-pushes, deletes a branch, or closes a PR on the target repositories as a side effect of authoring this manifest.

RECONSTRUCTION_LAYERS: candidate state (ACTIVE_CANDIDATE branches, open PRs) and integrated state (merged, default-branch history) are distinct layers and must never be conflated in a single disposition value.

RECEIPT_CHAIN: every repositories[].sources[] entry SHOULD carry a content_receipts object of {path: sha256hex}, computed by fetching the real bytes of each tracked path at the recorded sha via the GitHub Contents API and hashing them with sha256 (labeled sha256-observation); this is not required on every entry, and its absence on a given entry is not itself a defect, but where present it must be a real, independently computed digest, never asserted from memory.
FALSIFIER_EXACT_SOURCE_COMMIT: the verifier must hard-refuse if a recorded sha does not resolve to a real, fetchable commit on the named repository.
FALSIFIER_EXACT_SOURCE_TREE: the verifier must hard-refuse if a recorded content_receipts digest does not match a fresh sha256 computation over the real bytes at the recorded sha.

FALSIFIER_NO_UNCOMPUTED_DIGEST_CLAIM: the verifier must hard-refuse any content_receipts value that is not exactly 64 lowercase hex characters (a well-formed sha256 digest); a malformed or truncated digest string must never be silently accepted or padded.
FALSIFIER_NO_DIRECT_ACTUATION: the verifier must hard-refuse any manifest or receipt asserting direct_actuation=true or final_admission_allowed=true, since this program authors input only.
FALSIFIER_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: the verifier must hard-refuse if depends_on edges form a cycle across repositories[].

FALSIFIER_UNDECLARED_VALIDATION: the verifier must hard-refuse a repository entry whose validation_commands were not observed in that repository's own real CI/workflow definitions or scripts at the recorded sha.
